name: GroupifyAI

sources.title: Homepage — live AI tools & courses directory (claims 10k+ tools, 30–40 added daily); 'Submit New Tool' in nav
Submit New Tool — full listing form (tool details, category, functions, description, FAQs, pricing model, social links, tags)
Pricing — Basic Listing $29, Featured Listing, Promoted Listing (newsletter to 10K+), Enterprise Partnership; no free tier shown

conditions: Pricing page lists only paid plans — Basic Listing from $29 (48h homepage visibility, verified badge, do-follow link, dedicated tool page)
No free listing tier is advertised; the submission form exists but the pricing page frames listing as a paid service
requirements: Submission form at /new-tool-form: your name, company email, designation, tool name, tool URL, one category, up to 3 functions/departments
Short one-line keyword-rich description, long feature description, use cases, top 3 FAQs
Pricing model (free/freemium/paid) plus link to pricing page
At least one social media link, 3–10 relevant tags
Listings reviewed before publication per their terms; updates processed within 2 business days
Tools must comply with their ethical-AI content guidelines
preparation: Company email address (form asks specifically for 'Company Email ID')
Ready-to-paste short + long descriptions, use cases, 3 FAQs
Pricing page URL and at least one social link
Budget for at least the $29 Basic Listing if no free option appears at checkout
workflow: Open https://groupify.ai/new-tool-form and select 'Submit a new tool to GroupifyAI'
Fill basic info, tool details, category, functions, descriptions, use cases, FAQs, pricing, social links, tags
Submit and pay for a plan (Basic $29 / Featured / Promoted / Enterprise via /pricing)
Their team reviews; verified badge granted at their discretion; updates go live within 2 business days
For changes, use the same form's 'Update an existing tool' option
watchFor: Pricing page advertises '16,000+ users / 5,000+ tools' while homepage claims '20,000+ users / 10,000+ tools' — inconsistent self-reported stats
All purchases final; refunds only if service not delivered
Homepage visibility is time-boxed (48h on Basic) — long-tail value is the dedicated tool page and do-follow link
Cancellations for campaigns must go to info@groupify.ai ≥2 days before the scheduled run
countsAsLive: The tool has a dedicated page on groupify.ai reachable from a category page (e.g. /ai-productivity-tools), with description, tags, and do-follow link
unknowns: Whether any unpaid listing path exists via the form despite the paid-only pricing page
Review turnaround for the initial listing
Featured/Promoted listing prices (not displayed on the page)
